name: search-genie
description: Search Genie helps multi-market SEO and marketing teams measure brand visibility across AI assistants, compare competitor citations, review organic search and analytics performance, research keywords, identify content opportunities, and create private Search Genie reports and drafts.

interface.shortDescription: Track your brand in AI search
interface.longDescription: Search Genie helps multi-market SEO and marketing teams measure brand visibility across AI assistants, compare competitor citations, review organic search and analytics performance, research keywords, identify content opportunities, and create private Search Genie reports and drafts. It reads only the Search Genie workspace and brand you approve when connecting, and the access level you choose there decides whether it can also save private drafts.
capabilities: Read brand visibility in AI answers
defaultPrompt: Show my connected brand and open the Prompt Explorer.
What are the open recommendations for my brand?
How visible is my brand in AI answers in the UAE?

positive.description: Open the authorized demo brand and the interactive Prompt Explorer.
positive.prompt: Show my connected brand and open the Prompt Explorer card. Use stored data only.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected brand Horizon Outdoors (Demo) in the workspace Search Genie Review Demo — Synthetic Data, and opens the interactive Prompt Explorer card. The UAE and KSA markets are available. Nothing is generated, saved or changed.

positive.description: Inspect saved, explicitly synthetic prompt evidence.
positive.prompt: Find our UAE hiking-backpack prompt and compare its saved answers, dates, brand mentions and sources. Do not run new research.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the UAE hiking-backpack question and its two stored answers dated September 16 and 17, 2026. One answer does not mention the brand and one does. Says the answers are synthetic demo fixtures with no web sources. Runs no new research.

positive.description: Read recommendations and market-scoped catalogue data.
positive.prompt: Show open recommendations for our demo brand, then look up DEMO-DAYPACK-20 in the UAE catalog in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the open recommendation about clarifying daypack sizing on the category page, and the product Demo Trail Daypack 20L at AED 199, in stock, from the stored demo catalogue. Does not offer a purchase and does not claim live availability.

positive.description: List the private drafts already saved for the brand.
positive.prompt: List the private content drafts saved for our demo brand. Do not create or change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the private drafts saved for Horizon Outdoors (Demo) for the /daypacks page in the UAE in English, with their titles and last-updated dates, for example "Demo daypack buying checklist". Says that nothing was created or changed.

positive.description: Read share of voice from stored answers.
positive.prompt: From stored data only, what is our share of voice in AI answers in the UAE, and which brands are mentioned alongside us?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the share of voice for Horizon Outdoors (Demo) in the UAE from the two stored answers: the brand is mentioned in one of the two, and no other brand is mentioned alongside it. Says the figures come from synthetic demo data and that no new research was run.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general weather questions.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Dubai tomorrow?

negative.description: Do not trigger for email or calendar management.
negative.prompt: Email my team and schedule a meeting for next Monday.

negative.description: Do not trigger for purchases or public publishing.
negative.prompt: Buy this product and publish a promotional post to my website.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Privacy policy updated on November 3, 2026 (https://search-genie.waggle.ae/privacy): the data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, user controls, the tool inputs and outputs, the 90-day tool-call log and how to revoke access. Expired personal data is deleted by a daily job. Tool outputs now carry less: no publisher contact details in recommendations, only the label and metrics in analytics rows, only the record id in draft links, and a plain sentence instead of a database message when a tool fails. Long text in the tool-call log is cut to 200 characters. API keys are accepted only in the Authorization header. No tools, inputs or the MCP server address changed.
